name: Samuel Tulloch
text: Great place to get ur tax filed I got great newcomer bonuses. I am glad that I filed my taxes with them, We will also prefer their services.

name: Melinda
text: They applied for my Spouse and Parent's Visitor Visa which was approved in no time, Moreover, Got my taxes done here, and will be going here every year moving forward!! Great service. Would highly recommend!

name: James Brown
text: Cheapest place for getting Early USA Visa appointments. I had been scammed before by other companies, not only they helped me get my money back, but also got me an Early Visa Date in Toronto within 3 weeks.

name: Rahul P.
text: I had a great experience with their services. They guided me step by step in restoring my status and also helped me with my PGWP application. Everything was explained clearly, and they were always available to answer my questions and reduce my stress during a very difficult time. Their knowledge, professionalism, and timely support made the whole process smooth and successful. I truly appreciate their help and would highly recommend them to any student who needs assistance with immigration matters in Canada.

name: Rajveer
text: I’ve used CMS services for multiple services, including my tax filing, study permit extension, and immigration applications. They’ve been consistently excellent! The staff is incredibly knowledgeable and approachable, and they always go above and beyond to ensure success. It’s so reassuring to know I can rely on them for all my immigration and legal needs. Highly recommended!

name: Dhwani Gohel
text: CMS Services provided professional, knowledgeable, and attentive assistance with my Post-Graduate Work Permit (PGWP) application. They provided clear guidance on eligibility requirements and helped gather necessary documentation. Their thorough review and prompt responses ensured accurate submission and timely submission. Their exceptional customer service and prompt responses make them highly recommended for immigration and work permit assistance.

name: Michael Miller
text: Great place to file taxes, I can guarantee the kind of service they provide, they are the cheapest in Brampton, they handle creating your CRA account, setting up deposits and also any other forms that other places ask you to send, they do it themselves. I’ll say best place to go.

name: Sandeep Singh
text: CMS service helped me get out from a big mess, I almost lost my status. I recently completed my two one-year courses from college, then I applied for my PGWP. I don't know what went wrong but I was just issued a one-year work permit, I was in deep trouble. I contacted multiple agencies but none of them offered help, then I came across CMS services, they took all my trouble and fixed it without any hassle. I am grateful for their services. I am planning to get my tax filed by them too.
